title: Cameroonian truckers stop work on the Douala–Bangui corridor after a driver is killed in CAR
reason: Reports place the labor stoppage at Garoua-Boulaï/Cameroon and identify Cameroonian truckers; effects on Bangui supply do not establish a public gathering in CAR or demand on CAR state.
notes: The killing in CAR is context for the stoppage, not itself a protest event. The stoppage began around 18–20 November; the exact onset is not fixed here. Cross-border continuation into early December is recorded as an exclusion in that unit, not a CAR continuation.
